note: The ring of panels the player holds a key to open (ui/play/radial_menu.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). Each item is a panel `id` whose key is the action world_panel_<id> in input.json, so the ring and the keys cannot disagree. The ring is drawn round the mouse; holding the key and moving toward an item then releasing opens it, and a quick tap (under tap_seconds) leaves the ring up for a click. dead_radius is the middle where nothing is chosen; slot_w and slot_h are one item's box.

text.hint: Move toward one and let go
text.sticky_hint: Click one, or Tab again to close
